name: Representatives
description: The AI personas that act for a person or a team, each shaped by the way that person works.
purpose: Let an AI act for a person the way that person would want.
approach: Give each representative the person's judgment about asking and the person's feedback.
milestones: 1. A representative acts as its person would want (metric-ai-representatives).
measures_of_success: A representative acts as its person would want.
outputs: Actions and questions for one person.
usage_notes: No arm yet: the seat is defined and empty.

name: Asking Judgment
description: Deciding, for one person, whether to ask, proceed or decline, from the risk signal and what that person has said before. It shares one signal contract with the Nervous System.
purpose: Ask a person only when that person would want to be asked.
approach: Take a risk signal with its severity and reason, decide per person, and let feedback move the thresholds.
milestones: 1. The decision matches what the person would have chosen (metric-asking-judgment).
measures_of_success: The decision matches what the person would have chosen.
inputs: A risk signal with its severity and reason, and the person.
outputs: One decision for one person: ask, proceed or decline.
usage_notes: No arm yet: the seat is defined and empty.

name: Feedback Learning
description: Changing behaviour from a person's feedback: the thresholds for asking and the way the person wants the work done.
purpose: Make a person's correction last, so it is not given twice.
approach: Record each piece of feedback against what it corrected and adjust the behaviour it concerns.
milestones: 1. A correction given once is followed afterwards (metric-feedback-learning).
measures_of_success: A correction given once is followed afterwards.
outputs: Adjusted thresholds and preferences for one person.
